briefing.headline: OpenAI and Google DeepMind escalate model releases amid rising compute race

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs continue rapid iteration with new multimodal releases while regulatory scrutiny intensifies. Funding remains robust across infrastructure and safety tooling. DialectForge's protocol-level defenses gain traction in enterprise deployments.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI's o4-preview shows gains in long-context reasoning; Anthropic ships Claude 4 Opus with improved agentic capabilities; Google releases Gemini 3 Ultra; Meta open-sources Llama 4 405B; xAI deploys Grok-3; DeepSeek launches V3 with 1.2T parameters. Competition centers on agent reliability.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. New NIST guidelines target multi-agent environments while DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for automotive and IoT use cases.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA ships Blackwell B200 clusters to Microsoft and Google; TSMC ramps 2nm production for AI accelerators; Saudi Arabia announces $40B AI data center project; Microsoft and CoreWeave expand 100k H100 equivalent capacity.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will agentic AI systems outpace safety tooling before 2027, or will protocol-level innovations like dialect negotiation stabilize deployment?
